moments.title: BBC Proms in full swing
moments.blurb: The world's biggest classical music festival, BBC Proms, is well underway at the Royal Albert Hall and other UK venues, running until September 12 with a focus on American music this year.

angles.name: Classical Cool
angles.copy: Eighty-six concerts across eight weeks. The BBC Proms are a summer staple, celebrating American music this year. What's your favourite Proms moment?

angles.name: Royal Albert Hall vibes
angles.copy: From classical giants to new discoveries, the BBC Proms continue their epic run at the Royal Albert Hall. Perfect for a dose of culture this week!

moments.title: Bruno Mars lights up Wembley
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Bruno Mars plays Wembley Stadium tomorrow, July 28, as part of his highly anticipated UK shows.

angles.name: Wembley excitement
angles.copy: Wembley, are you ready? Bruno Mars brings his incredible show to the stadium tomorrow! Get ready for some Uptown Funk!

angles.name: Last minute tickets?
angles.copy: Still time to catch Bruno Mars at Wembley! If you're heading there tomorrow, prepare for a night of pure pop gold.

moments.title: Luke Combs takes over Wembley
moments.blurb: Country music sensation Luke Combs performs two massive shows at Wembley Stadium on July 31 and August 1, bringing his chart-topping hits to London.

angles.name: Country invades London
angles.copy: Yee-haw, London! Luke Combs is set to deliver two unforgettable nights at Wembley Stadium this weekend. Who's got their boots ready?

angles.name: Wembley weekend
angles.copy: From 'Beautiful Crazy' to 'Beer Never Broke My Heart', Luke Combs is bringing his A-game to Wembley Stadium this Friday and Saturday. Don't miss it!

moments.title: Gary Numan's UK dates
moments.blurb: Synth-rock pioneer Gary Numan has two upcoming UK shows: The Piece Hall in Halifax on July 31 and Palace Bowl Presents on August 6.

angles.name: Numan in Halifax
angles.copy: The legendary Gary Numan is at The Piece Hall in Halifax this Friday! Get ready for a masterclass in electronic rock.

angles.name: Synth-rock icon
angles.copy: From 'Are 'Friends' Electric?' to modern classics, Gary Numan continues to tour. Catch him at Palace Bowl Presents on August 6th!

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival approaches
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest surf and music festival, Boardmasters, kicks off in Newquay, Cornwall from August 5-9, featuring headliners like Fatboy Slim, Kasabian, The Kooks, and Loyle Carner.

angles.name: Cornwall countdown
angles.copy: Boardmasters is just around the corner! Get ready for a wicked week of surf, music, and Cornish vibes in Newquay from August 5-9. Who's coming?

angles.name: Festival Lineup Shoutout
angles.copy: Fatboy Slim, Kasabian, The Kooks, Loyle Carner... the Boardmasters lineup is stacked! Get ready for some epic sets next week.

angles.name: Surf & Music
angles.copy: Sun, sea, surf, and sensational music! Boardmasters is the ultimate summer festival experience. Counting down the days!

moments.title: Happy 63rd to James Hetfield
moments.blurb: Metallica frontman James Hetfield celebrates his 63rd birthday on August 3.

angles.name: Metal legend's birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass! James Hetfield of Metallica turns 63 on August 3rd. What's your favourite Metallica riff?

angles.name: Metallica frontman
angles.copy: Happy 63rd birthday to the legendary James Hetfield! From 'Enter Sandman' to 'Master of Puppets', his voice defines a generation of metal.

moments.title: Skin turns 59
moments.blurb: Skunk Anansie frontwoman Skin (Deborah Anne Dyer) celebrates her 59th birthday on August 3.

angles.name: Skunk Anansie's icon
angles.copy: Happy 59th birthday to the incredible Skin from Skunk Anansie on August 3rd! A true rock icon.

angles.name: Powerful voice
angles.copy: Celebrating Skin's 59th birthday this week! Her powerful vocals and stage presence with Skunk Anansie are unforgettable.

moments.title: Yungblud's 29th birthday
moments.blurb: British rock singer Yungblud (Dominic Harrison) turns 29 on August 5.

angles.name: Yungblud turns 29
angles.copy: Happy 29th birthday to the one and only Yungblud on August 5th! What's your favourite track from the Doncaster rocker?

angles.name: Gen Z icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Yungblud's birthday! He's been rocking the charts and stages with his unique sound. Big love to Dominic Harrison!

moments.title: Pat Smear is 67
moments.blurb: Foo Fighters and former Nirvana guitarist Pat Smear turns 67 on August 5.

angles.name: Rock legend's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the iconic Pat Smear on August 5th! From Germs to Nirvana to Foo Fighters, what a career!

angles.name: Guitar hero
angles.copy: A true guitar hero! Sending birthday wishes to Pat Smear this week. His contributions to rock are immense.

moments.title: Geri Halliwell turns 54
moments.blurb: Spice Girls icon Geri Halliwell, known as Ginger Spice, celebrates her 54th birthday on August 6.

angles.name: Ginger Spice's day
angles.copy: Girl Power! Geri Halliwell turns 54 on August 6th. What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?

angles.name: Pop icon birthday
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the fabulous Geri Halliwell! Still bringing the sparkle after all these years. Have a spicy one!

moments.title: Donna Lewis is 66
moments.blurb: Welsh singer-songwriter Donna Lewis, best known for her hit 'I Love You Always Forever', celebrates her 66th birthday on August 6.

angles.name: Welsh voice turns 66
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Welsh singer Donna Lewis on August 6th! 'I Love You Always Forever' is still a timeless hit.

angles.name: 90s classic
angles.copy: That iconic voice! Wishing a very happy birthday to Donna Lewis. What's your favourite memory associated with her biggest hit?

moments.title: UK Summer Holidays in full swing
moments.blurb: Schools across the UK are well into their summer holidays, with most students in England and Wales off until early September, and Scottish schools returning mid-August.

angles.name: Summer vibes
angles.copy: It's peak summer holiday season across the UK! Whether you're staycationing or jetting off, enjoy the break and soak up the sun (hopefully!).

angles.name: Family fun
angles.copy: School's out for summer! What are your plans for making the most of the holidays with family and friends?
